responsibility: This implementation module realizes the gm2 dynamic indexing container as a resizable ADDRESS array allocated from Storage and manipulated with libc memset/memmove. It maintains low/high bounds, occupancy tracking, optional debug bookkeeping, and helpers for insertion, lookup, deletion, membership testing, appending unique entries, and foreach traversal, serving as the runtime’s general expandable index mechanism rather than a domain-specific table.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation of the Indexing container, defining the concrete record with ArrayStart/Low/High/Used state and the realloc/memset/memmove logic that realizes the abstract operations declared in Indexing.def.
